name: Webhook
description: Start a run whenever an HTTP request hits this workflow's unique URL.

inputs.label: Check incoming requests
inputs.help: Only accept requests that prove they come from your app. Requests that fail get an error and start nothing.

inputs.label: Header name
inputs.help: The app must send the secret below in this header.

inputs.label: Signature header
inputs.help: GitHub: X-Hub-Signature-256. Shopify: X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256. WooCommerce: X-WC-Webhook-Signature.

inputs.label: Signature prefix
inputs.help: Text before the signature, like GitHub's "sha256=". It's ignored when the app doesn't send it.

inputs.label: Secret
inputs.help: Secret header: make up a long random text and set the same in your app. Basic auth: the password. Signatures: paste the signing secret from the app (Stripe → Developers → Webhooks, starts with whsec_; Slack → your app → Basic Information → Signing Secret; GitHub, Shopify and WooCommerce show it where you add the webhook).

inputs.label: Test payload (JSON)
inputs.help: Used by "Test workflow". Leave empty to use the last request captured while the workflow was inactive.
